messages:
alex: Kicking off Orpheus EAP bench + telemetry sync. Need NDA status, firmware drop ETA, and list of sample workloads we want them to run. Can we get leads on each?
maria: NDA is signed by legal, waiting on Orpheus countersign. @maria to follow up with Laura at Orpheus today. ETA 48h if no redlines.
tariq: For firmware — Orpheus promised FW v1.2.3 next week. Need to confirm whether it contains the thermal logging patch we asked for.
orpheus-eng: We expect to push v1.2.3 Wed. Thermal logging patch included, but will require a small config change on your side to enable extended telemetry.
alex: Good. Can you paste the config snippet we need to flip? Also we need the exact field names for the CSV telemetry so our parser can ingest without manual mapping.
orpheus-eng: Sure — use the agent flag:
```
telemetry_agent --enable-extended --out-format=csv --fields=time,temp_core,temp_pwr,fan_rpm
```
CSV header will be: timestamp,temp_core_c,temp_power_w,fan_rpm
sam: Note: our ingestion expects temp in C and power in W. If you send mW we'll need a conversion. Also ask them to include CPU and GPU counters if available.
maria: Marketplace listing: we need assets (logo, short blurb, tested model list). Who owns that copy? Product or Partnerships?
alex: Partnerships will own listing copy but need product to sign off on model compatibility blurb. @sam can you compile the tested model list (LLama-2-7B, Mistral-7B, Redstone-13B lite) and rough throughput numbers?
sam: Will compile. Quick numbers: LLama-2-7B @ 512 tokens = ~120 qps on a single Orpheus node (batch=8), Mistral-7B ~95 qps. I'll add memory/latency breakdowns in the doc.
orpheus-eng: For benchmarks, we prefer running your suite vs. our synthetic. Can you send an Ansible job or a container image? We can run within our lab under NDA.
tariq: Prefer container image. We'll provide docker hub creds (ephemeral) and a small runner script. Security note: we will only allow the runner inside their isolated bench VLAN and will scrub any logs containing keys.
ops-bot: Reminder: fill out the EAP checklist here -> https://redwood.internal/eap-checklist  :white_check_mark: 
alex: Timeline proposal: week 0 NDA sign, week 1 FW drop + container handoff, week 2 dry-run telemetry, week 3 full benchmark. Does that align with Orpheus?
orpheus-eng: That works. Can we request one day of on-call from Redwood infra during the dry-run in case we hit kernel issues?
alex: Yes, we can allocate 4hr on-call window for the dry-run. @sam and @tariq can you be available?
sam: I can take the dry-run on Thurs 10-2 PT.
tariq: I'm good for Thurs 12-4 PT (overlap OK).
maria: Legal will ping when NDA countersigned. I'll also start drafting the joint announcement outline — but won't publish until both sides agree on benchmark language.
alex: One more: telemetry retention — we need raw telemetry for 30 days. Orpheus, can you store raw logs for at least 30d before rotation?
orpheus-eng: Yes, we can retain 45d rolling in the bench cluster and provide SFTP access for the first 30d.
alex: Awesome. I'll update the EAP tracker and add action items. Closing notes: action items for Orpheus (FW drop, container access, CSV header), for us (build container, ingestion parser, on-call slots). Thanks :rocket:
sam: I'll draft the model perf table and upload to the tracker by EOD.
